---
title: Tuna Pâté
id: MAR-0011
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 50
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 300 g tuna in oil
- 120 g butter
- 5 anchovy fillets
- to taste mayonnaise
## Method
1. Drain the tuna from the oil and crumble it finely, add the chopped anchovies and the butter cut into pieces at room temperature.
2. Work the ingredients by pressing them with a fork and mixing until they are completely amalgamated, forming a creamy mixture.
3. Transfer the preparation to a bowl, cover it, and put it in the refrigerator to solidify for a few hours.
4. Serve the tuna pâté garnished with mayonnaise.
